title: Evidence Workbench local evidence handoff registry wrapper v1
description: Wraps one evidence-handoff/v1 object. Shape parsing alone does not verify lineage; EWB registry reads must re-verify same-workspace plan, run, artifact-record, run-membership, and CAS state. Verification does not create a verdict, status, score, pass state, or authority.

record_digest.description: SHA-256 over compact typed JSON for the evidence-handoff/v1 object, not the enclosing registry file.
